fields.description: Issue features editorials and commentary on the upcoming Miami city election, including criticism and satire about voting, reform claims, and public-utility franchises associated with Florida Power & Light. Coverage includes discussion of courthouse construction contracts and inspection concerns, transportation and transit issues (buses, jitneys, and rail lines), and a column on racial employment practices on the Florida East Coast Railway. The issue also references flood relief efforts for the Mississippi Valley and includes political advertisements and local civic notices.
